sources.summary: AI hardware bottlenecks are expanding beyond GPUs to the PCBs underneath them. As AI servers like Rubin Ultra push PCB layers toward 78 layers using denser laminates, drill bits are wearing out 10 times faster than normal, while high-speed signalling stretches the demand for smooth copper foil.

sources.title_original: Texas lifts freeze on 1,800+ data center projects in Greg Abbott U-turn
sources.summary: After pausing the approval of new data center building permits in August, Texas has now reversed the decision and has once again begun approving applications as builders rush to get the go-ahead before Democratic governor Gina Hinojosa's January arrival.
sources.summary_zh: 在八月份暂停批准新的数据中心建筑许可证后，德克萨斯州现在推翻了这一决定，并再次开始批准申请，因为建筑商急于在民主党州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨 (Gina Hinojosa) 一月份上任之前获得批准。
